def components(g):
    H,W = g.shape
    lab = -np.ones((H,W),int); n=0
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]==1 and lab[i,j]<0:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); lab[i,j]=n
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft()
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            a,b=r+dr,c+dc
                            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a,b]==1 and lab[a,b]<0:
                                lab[a,b]=n; q.append((a,b))
                n+=1
    return lab,n

def solve(g):
    H,W = g.shape
    out = g.copy()
    lab,n = components(g)
    # global flood of 0s from border, 4-conn, blocked by 1s
    reach = np.zeros((H,W),bool)
    q = deque()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in (0,W-1):
            if g[i,j]==0 and not reach[i,j]: reach[i,j]=True; q.append((i,j))
    for j in range(W):
        for i in (0,H-1):
            if g[i,j]==0 and not reach[i,j]: reach[i,j]=True; q.append((i,j))
    while q:
        r,c = q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b = r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a,b]==0 and not reach[a,b]:
                reach[a,b]=True; q.append((a,b))
    enclosed = (g==0)&(~reach)
    for k in range(n):
        cells = np.argwhere((lab==k))
        rs,cs = cells[:,0],cells[:,1]
        r0,r1,c0,c1 = rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(),cs.max()
        D = set(map(tuple,cells))
        hints = [(r,c) for (r,c) in D if r0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1]
        E = [(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)
             if g[r,c]==0 and enclosed[r,c]]
        if not hints and not E:
            continue  # unchanged
        # interior fill
        for (r,c) in E:
            dmin = min(max(abs(r-a),abs(c-b)) for (a,b) in D)
            out[r,c] = 3 if dmin==1 else 0
        # dilation ring on non-enclosed, non-D cells
        for r in range(max(0,r0-1),min(H,r1+2)):
            for c in range(max(0,c0-1),min(W,c1+2)):
                if (r,c) in D or enclosed[r,c]: continue
                if any(max(abs(r-a),abs(c-b))==1 for (a,b) in D):
                    out[r,c] = 2
    return out
